protectedAutoInterrupted: Allow all is selected, but this step still needs confirmation:
protectedOnceOnly: . Confirm this step only; it cannot join allowlist or auto-run.
policyAskEveryTime: Ask every time (allow this step only)
policyUseAllowlist: On-demand confirm (ask only for risky actions)
protectedReasonHigh: this action is marked high risk
protectedReasonDestructive: this action would delete or overwrite existing content
protectedReasonComputerUse: this action would read or control the desktop
protectedReasonNonWhitelisted: this command is not on the default allowlist
protectedReasonPolicy: this action would change skills or long-term memory settings
protectedReasonUnknown: risk could not be determined, so it is treated as protected
